Chennai Metro Rail Limited redesigned a critical stretch between Alandur and St Thomas Mount to avoid acquiring defence land. The revised alignment involves constructing Phase 2 of Corridor 5 beneath the existing Chennai Central to St Thomas Mount corridor. This change is expected to save six months of construction time. raw.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited submitted a media release regarding its subsidiary Kutch Copper Ltd and Chile’s Codelco signing a strategic Memorandum of Understanding for the exploration of the Kaburkaala copper project in Chile. The agreement aims to link Chilean copper resources with Adani’s integrated copper smelter complex at Mundra, India. The MoU was signed in London during LME Week 2026. This partnership involves capital, technology-led exploration, and project execution capabilities from Adani, combined with Codelco’s geological knowledge. The collaboration supports India’s resource security and Codelco’s strategy to create value from its exploration portfolio through public-private partnerships.

raw.voiceSummary: Tata Power reported its highest-ever quarterly Profit After Tax of 1,652 crore for Q2 FY27, up 33 percent year-on-year. Half-year PAT reached 3,053 crore, up 22 percent. raw.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited submitted a media release regarding Kutch Copper Limited. Kutch Copper Limited is a unit of Adani Enterprises Limited. The company received the Veramark Assurance certification. This certification was formerly known as Copper Mark. Kutch Copper Limited is the first Indian producer to receive this recognition. The framework promotes responsible copper production. It involves independent third-party audits of environmental, social, and governance performance. The certification aligns with United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. Specifically, it supports goal twelve on responsible consumption and production. The announcement was made on November 11, 2026. Dr. Vinay Prakash is the Managing Director of Kutch Copper Limited. He stated the milestone positions the company among leading global producers. The recognition establishes Kutch Copper Limited as a trusted supplier of responsibly produced copper.

rows.headline: General Updates
rows.subject: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Reference to the Financial Results issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation

raw.attchmntText: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Reference to the Financial Results issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation
raw.voiceSummary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited filed a reference to the Financial Results for the first six months of FY 2026 issued by Suzuki Motor Corporation in Japan on 10th November 2026. Suzuki Motor Corporation reported consolidated revenue of 1,466.5 billion yen for the period, an increase of 16.8 percent year-on-year. Operating profit was 134.3 billion yen, a decrease of 0.6 percent. Profit before tax stood at 156.5 billion yen, down 24.5 percent. Profit attributable to owners of parent was 90.8 billion yen, a decline of 22.8 percent. The company noted increased revenue but decreased profit. Foreign exchange rates and raw material prices were cited as external factors affecting results. Capital expenditures were 87.3 billion yen. Interest-bearing debt balance was 736.0 billion yen. Cash balance was 930.0 billion yen. The filing was submitted by Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary.

raw.attchmntText: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about newspaper Advertisement   Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )
raw.voiceSummary: Tata Steel Limited published a newspaper advertisement regarding the audited Standalone and unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published in The Free Press Journal, The Indian Express, Financial Express, Navshakti, and Loksatta. It includes a Quick Response Code and a weblink to access the financial results. This disclosure complies with Regulation 47 read with other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The information is also available on the company website at www.tatasteel.com. Separately, State Bank of India issued an e-auction sale notice for immovable properties under the SARFAESI Act. The auction is scheduled for December 9, 2026, between 11:00 am and 4:00 pm. Properties include a flat in Vasai East with a reserve price of Rs. 11,00,000 and a flat in Kulgaon with a reserve price of Rs. 26,00,000. HDFC Bank also published a notice under Section 13 of the SARFAESI Act regarding the sale of secured assets. The auction date is November 9, 2026.

raw.attchmntText: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited ( ACX ), a joint venture of the Company.
raw.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited confirms the completion of the acquisition of a 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited, a joint venture of the Company. This transaction was executed under a share purchase agreement with Adani Infra India Limited, the seller. The completion follows the earlier intimation dated November 6, 2026. With this acquisition, Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited has become a joint venture of Adani Enterprises Limited. The details of the acquisition were previously furnished pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.
